notes.atticInsulationDepthIn: BOTH-case: a measured depth ("eleven, twelve inches") AND an R-value ("R-38") are stated. The band comes from the DEPTH -> 10-12 (11-12 in falls in the 10-12 band). Do NOT source the band from R-38.
notes.atticInsulationSpokenRValue: 38 is still captured in the holding-pen even though a depth exists, per prompt rule 8 ("if both, fill the band from the depth and still record the R-value").
notes.heatingEquipmentType: WRONG-FIELD trap: the transcript describes a DECOMMISSIONED old floor furnace / oil pot burner in the basement, and the auditor repeatedly says not to log it. Heating must be the WORKING propane Carrier furnace. A model that emits fuel_oil (from the old unit) or stove_or_insert/direct_heater (the old gravity unit) has taken a value present in the audio but explicitly excluded by the auditor.
notes.heatingFuel: propane, NOT fuel_oil. fuel_oil is only attached to the dead unit the auditor excludes.
notes.coolingEquipmentType: central_ac_standalone_ducts: the AC has its own attic air handler and duct runs, explicitly standalone. Distinct from a shared-duct AC (which would be folded into heatingEquipmentType=furnace_central_ac). Here they are genuinely separate systems.
notes.combustionVentType: direct_vented for the furnace (PVC, sealed combustion, side-wall). This is the furnace's CAZ vent type. The water heater is tankless and spilled but no vent-system-type token was spoken for it.
notes.dhwAgeBand: null with a span: the auditor explicitly could not find an age tag ("no age tag I could find"). "it's newer" is not a band. Do not bucket a guess.
notes._general: No-field distractors that must be dropped: "ninety-six percent" (an AFUE/efficiency, no capture slot per HAZARD 4 -- must not land in heatingOutputCapacityBtuh); "six point one ACH50" (ACH50 has NO field in this schema, and is NOT the blower-door CFM50 slot -- 2800 is); the sunroom being "single-glazed on three sides" (predominant house glazing is double pane, and the sunroom is called outside the thermal boundary); "poured concrete" foundation (not exterior wall construction); Nest thermostat, LED lighting, chest freezer, beer fridge, dryer and bath-fan venting (real notes, no fields). "forty-one Maple" is a house number.
